hints.title: Row by Row Subset Sum
hints.text: Maintain the set of all possible sums formed by picking one element per row from the first r rows.

hints.title: Pruning Excess Sums
hints.text: Notice that if a sum already exceeds target, any further increase cannot be closer to target than the smallest sum above target.

hints.title: Bitset Representation
hints.text: Represent attainable sums using a boolean array or bitset. Shift the bitset by each element in the row and take the bitwise OR.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Dynamic programming keeping reachable sums pruned beyond target.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all N^M combinations leads to exponential branching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Discarding duplicate sums and pruning sums past the smallest exceeding value keeps the state size bounded by target.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize knapsack-style sum tracking with upper-bound pruning.
